correctness.rationale: For all n>=4 unique parity synchronization of length-four factors separates even-start mu(u) and odd-start b(v). Even circular shifts preserve the desubstituted conjugacy class; closed-end extensions add one odd-start member, while non-closed odd-start words have a forced internal equal-pair obstruction and no distinct occurring rotation. This yields the all-length inflation multiset. Desubstitution of closed extensions and the explicitly checked n=4 base gives the full dyadic spectrum one n-class, three 2-classes and 2n-8 singletons. The proof is infinite; prefix enumeration verifies only n<=128.
